approved_word_links.editorial_rationale: This original token names the Zebulun settlement Rimmon in Joshua 19:13. The independently attested UBS 'Rimmono' headword denotes the same Zebulun Levite town (compare 1 Chronicles 6:77). BDB explicitly links Joshua 19:13 Rimmon with 1 Chronicles 6:77 Rimmono; the distinct Judah/Simeon and rock namesakes in this original family are NOT approved for automatic linking.

The original WLC verb in 1 Samuel 17:39 is וַיֹּאֶל 'he undertook/tried', Strong H2974a, in the exact original word position. The independent BDB lexicon cites this occurrence under the יאל / H2974 verb meaning 'voluntarily undertake' and UBS 0.9.4 indexes יאל with H2974 and the same willingness/resolve lexeme. Preserve MACULA's original lemma annotation אלה and exact source Strong suffix unchanged; accept only an entry-level cross-edition lookup for this source word without choosing a textual variant or contextual sense ID.
